description: A girl asking the player out for Sunday: all of SERIFU/G_INVITE.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6o), 351 strings, plus the 19 meeting-place names in EXEDIR/GEKO.EXN (0x15988, 19 x 33-byte records, "slot": 33) that {M} inserts. Thirteen sections: one per girl (girl ids 0-10 map to sections 1,5,2,3,10,6,8,4,0,9,12), section 11 the player's thoughts after turning her down, section 7 selected by no girl id (translated anyway). Each girl's section: greeting and "are you free Sunday?" with the player's choice, one invitation per place (parts 1-19 = places 2-20), his answer, "Meet at {M}?", her goodbye, and her reaction when refused (part 23). Lines identical to walk_home.json reuse its English. Verified in DuckStation with force_event.py --type 0x46 from the 95/4/23 Sunday state: Shiori's invitation (zoo) accepted through "Meet at {M}" and the thought, Shiori refused (her reply and the regret thought), Yuko's invitation (arcade) accepted with the English meeting place "the arcade", after which her Sunday date starts. Checked only statically: the other nine girls, the other places and meeting-place names, the unused section 7, natural triggers.
